stem: Radicles emerge, but many seedlings fail after emergence in persistently saturated media. What is the best next reasoning step?
choices: Count every radicle as a successfully established seedling.
Treat establishment as a separate outcome and evaluate root-zone aeration/moisture, sanitation and plant-health evidence.
Assume genetics are the only cause.
Increase water without checking media condition.
rationale: Treat establishment as a separate outcome and evaluate root-zone aeration/moisture, sanitation and plant-health evidence.
